description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 截图设置窗口记住你拖出来的大小，下次打开、重启后都是这个大小，上次最大化的仍然最大化；双击窗口边框恢复默认大小。不想要可以在 Win顺 的 设置 › 外观 › 记住窗口大小 关掉（Win顺 0.40.0 起有这个开关）。权限不变。
notes.en: The Screenshot settings window keeps the size you leave it at, after a restart too, maximized if you left it so; a double click on its edge gives it the default size. Turn this off under WinShun's Settings › Appearance › Remember window sizes (WinShun 0.40.0 and later). Permissions unchanged.
